issues: The page was light-grey placeholder UI (a Dropbox glyph, a stray giant W, blank tiles): no section was worth watching and the product was unclear
The light-grey page read as a white slab on the dark stage, with only a purple glow on the left for light
The glide was near-linear, so the rhythm was flat and the tail had no landing; the last frame was not a composed image
Speed ghosts sat under the opaque page and only peeked out at its edges; the float-and-land used fake 2D offsets
changes: Lime look (graphite stage and neon yellow-green): the page is a dark product long-page designed for the shot (fictional running app STRIDE 4) with five 'carriages': a 200px headline, a 4:12 pace card, heart-rate zones with Z4 as hero, a 12.4 km route card and 'Run smarter.' with a neon button

Camera constants (60°, perspective 1100, origin 30% 58%) are untouched, still object-moves-camera-locked; the glide now runs on bezier(0.36,0.08,0.32,0.94), slow-fast-slow, easing into a creep with a non-zero tail slope so the last frame is a readable closing poster
Float-and-land is true 3D: cards hover in front of the page via translateZ inside preserve-3d and drop as they slide into the reading zone, their soft shadows tightening as they land
Speed ghosts are now dense trails at f-0.5/-1.0/-1.5 composited above the page with lighten blending, only at high speed, so bright type and neon parts smear continuously

Light: a neon key light fixed in camera space that the page slides under, a neon rim along the top edge and far fog; filter: blur was removed from the 3D layers (shadows are radial gradients), taking the render from white frames and 4+ minutes to ~40s; duration 120→150f
